subject: Retirement
details: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement of Mr. Noel N Tata as the Chairman
headline_summary: Trent announces retirement of Noel N Tata as Chairman.

data.role_transition: Retiring from the office of Chairman and Director with effect from the close of business hours on 11th November 2026, and appointed as Chairman Emeritus with effect from 12th November 2026.
data.background_bio: Mr. Noel N. Tata has been associated with Trent Limited since 1997, providing exemplary leadership and strategic direction throughout his tenure. Under his stewardship, the company achieved significant milestones, strengthened its market position, and delivered sustained growth and value for its stakeholders over the past 29 years.

subject: Press Release
details: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 29, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for thesecond quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026".
headline_summary: Trent issues press release detailing standalone and consolidated Q2 FY27 results.

data.key_takeaway: Trent Limited delivered robust consolidated performance with operating revenue growing 22% YoY and operating EBITDA expanding 37% YoY driven by solid traction across its lifestyle and retail concepts.

headline_summary: L&T reports standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for Q2 FY27.

data.key_takeaway: L&T delivered strong consolidated revenue growth of 15.8% YoY and a 32.5% YoY surge in PAT aided by lower finance costs, despite EBITDA margin contracting 130 bps YoY to 8.7% due to execution mix and cost pressures.

data.background_bio: Rajiv Dube is a seasoned corporate executive with nearly four decades of multi-industry leadership experience across the automotive and industrial manufacturing sectors. He previously served as an Executive Director on the Board of Tata Motors and later as a Group Executive Board Member and President at the Aditya Birla Group.
